title: Comtrade 360's only gap as a design partner is its unverified open-source posture
content:
Comtrade 360 reads as pure custom programming, which is the profile the design-partner search is looking for. At 89 people there is no in-house product occupying the application layer, so nothing internal has to be displaced for an application built on Powerhouse to sit there. The research also puts the decision inside one conversation: at that headcount the person who can say yes is reachable directly rather than through a partner-alliance function.

The single unresolved axis is open-source posture, which was not researched. That matters because every other qualifying signal here is structural — size, an empty app-layer slot, decision latency — and posture is the one thing that has to be observed rather than inferred from shape. Until it is checked the profile cannot be called ideal, only ideal-except-for-one-thing, which is why the lead sits at priority 2 rather than at the front of the queue.

Commercially this is the cheapest kind of next step. A single pass over public repositories and licence choices resolves the last gap on an otherwise complete profile, and if it passes, Comtrade 360 moves up without any further research being needed.
